 When is Coachella 2027? Full festival dates, headliners Dua Lipa, SZA and Tame Impala, lineup and ticket details
 The official lineup for Coachella 2027 features Dua Lipa, Tame Impala and SZA as headliners, alongside Madonna and several other performers.(Image credit: Coachella/Facebook)
 Synopsis
 Coachella 2027 has announced its lineup featuring major artists such as Dua Lipa, Tame Impala, and SZA. The festival will occur at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California, across two weekends in April. Passes for the event are set to go on sale on November 13, 2026, through the official website. Additional performers include Madonna, Phoebe Bridgers, and Kygo among others.
 By Shilpasree Mondal & ET Entertainment Desk , Global Desk Nov 11, 2026, 01:56:00 PM IST Follow us Coachella 2027 just dropped the lineup of the performers, which includes Dua Lipa , Tame Impala and SZA . The music and arts festival will return to the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California, on April 9–11 and April 16–18, 2027. Passes are scheduled to go on sale on November 13, according to the festival's official website.
 ADVERTISEMENT Who else is performing at Coachella 2027?
Some of the major names announced for the festival include Madonna, Diljit Dosanjh, JISOO, Phoebe Bridgers, Weezer, Robyn, Måneskin, Don Toliver, Becky G and Kygo.
 Friday lineup
Dua Lipa will headline Friday, April 9 and April 16. The day's lineup also includes Madonna, Zara Larsson, Steve Lacy, JISOO, Diljit Dosanjh, Peggy Gou, Kehlani, Leon Thomas and Giorgio Moroder. 
Madonna is listed for a performance in the Dance Tent. The Los Angeles Times and Variety have also highlighted her appearance as one of the major talking points from the announcement. 
 Also Read: Why are Dancing With the Stars fans criticizing Maren Morris' performance of “The Middle” on Grammy Night? 
 Saturday lineup
Tame Impala will headline Saturday, April 10 and April 17. Other performers listed for the day include Phoebe Bridgers, Weezer, Robyn, Måneskin, Role Model, Leon Bridges, NCT, Tiësto, Martin Garrix and Underworld.
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 Sunday lineup
SZA will headline Sunday, April 11 and April 18. The day's performers include Don Toliver, Dom Dolla, Kygo, Empire of the Sun, The Neighbourhood, Becky G, BABYMONSTER, Victoria Monét and Jorja Smith.
These are selected performers from the announced lineup. Readers can check the official Coachella website for the complete artist list.

 How to purchase tickets for Coachella 2027?
You can purchase Coachella 2027 passes through the festival's official website at coachella.com. The general pass sale is scheduled for Friday, November 13, 2026, at noon Pacific Time, according to the festival's website.
There is also an option to experience it online. Fans can visit Coachella's official YouTube channel to follow livestream updates and watch performances.
